lines.text: You have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, and my love.
I endured persecutions in Antioch, Iconium, and Derbe, yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
All who desire godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted, while evil men go from bad to worse.
Continue in what you learned; the Holy Scriptures can make you wise for salvation through works.
All Scripture is God-breathed and useful for instruction, so that the man of God may be complete.
